items.summary: fix(ci): validate frozen targets without executing candidate code (#144023) * fix(ci): run frozen bundle clients from their shipped layout Resolve only the selected bundle contract with local committed-object reads and trusted syntax parsing. Preserve each legacy client's manifest, helper, import depth and bytes before Docker staging, and reject unknown or unreadable contracts. * fix(ci): preserve frozen source read failures Distinguish committed absence from missing, corrupt, or wrong-kind Git objects before selecting frozen compatibility. Share bounded local-only source reads across the shell and bundle resolver, and preserve errors through conditional callers before gateway Docker work. This is the source-read stage only; aggregate frozen admission remains separate. * fix(ci): isolate frozen consumer contracts * fix(ci): add inert frozen target admission * fix(ci): validate Docker lane alias contracts

items.title: fix(ui): restore Send when Stop finds a finished run (#143437)
items.summary: fix(ui): restore Send when Stop finds a finished run (#143437) Closes #143356. ## What Problem This Solves Fixes an issue where clicking Stop leaves the Control UI stuck on a completed run when its terminal notifications did not reach the browser. The Gateway answers that nothing is active, but the composer keeps Stop until the page is refreshed. ## Why This Change Was Made The shared Stop handler now consumes explicit no-active-run answers from `chat.abort` and `sessions.abort` and invokes the existing authoritative chat refresh. The session owner decides whether the run is finished. Recovery checks the captured connection, client, session, run (including no local run), and selected agent before refreshing, so a delayed answer cannot refresh replacement work. This preserves @ylcn91's contribution and all nine original commits. The regression drives an authenticated Control UI and real Gateway, with a deterministic fixture provider and narrowly withheld terminal notifications. The test owns its server and runs in the serial browser lane. ## User Impact Stop can restore Send and the completed reply without a page reload. Finalizing work retains its activity and tool progress. Accepted live aborts still settle through lifecycle events. Drafts, queued exact-run stops, descendant activity, error recovery, and Gateway abort authority retain their existing behavior. ## Evidence - On pinned main `71b21c88574752cd9acc917970ec2850279cdfa2`, one real turn reaches an authoritative inactive/done state. Four exact-run terminal notifications are withheld on one connected WebSocket; ordinary replies and chat deltas continue. Stop receives `{ok:true, aborted:false, runIds:[]}`, yet the browser keeps the same run and Stop for ten seconds without refreshing history. - On candidate runtime `727574f45fca7a0cf0e15604d7e209cb987d844b`, the same real flow refreshes history after that answer, reads the matching terminal session and run, clears local ownership, shows the finished reply, and restores Send. The full private capture and the corrected committed regression pass. Later test-only corrections read session identity from the Gateway's existing history delta response and omit a redundant default type argument, and include the new private-server test in the existing CI ownership guard; runtime inputs are unchanged. - 53 focused lifecycle/abort tests, 43 test-routing checks, and both affected serial-ownership controls pass. The two added replacement-run/selected-agent tests first fail on contributor code for the intended ownership violations. Scoped formatting, lint, canonical commit hooks, and normal Gateway/UI builds pass. UI startup size remains within the existing limit. - All 17 mock-browser scenarios have applicable passing evidence across retained runs, including finalizing tools, accepted abort, session-only direct/descendant recovery, failed history followed by another Stop, and existing reconnect/queued-stop controls. Earlier fixture failures and skipped selections are retained; this is not one new whole-file 17/17 run. Ownership races also have focused tests and source review, rather than an exhaustive browser permutation claim. Terminal-event withholding is deliberate fault injection. The provider is a deterministic fixture, not live-model proof. This repairs recovery after a no-active-run answer; it does not establish or fix the reporter's natural notification-loss cause. The new real-test draft is entered after recovery; draft survival across Stop is covered separately by focused tests. The first committed regression expected full-history-only identity fields from a valid delta response and failed after the composer recovered. Its corrected assertion checks the exact identity in `sessionInfo`; the original failure and successful private capture remain in the evidence. Full raw traces and state remain private. Public images are inspected crops that remove session headers and the fixture prompt. | Before: Stop remains after the no-active-run answer | After: completed reply and Send restored | | --- | --- | | ![Stale Stop after the Gateway completed](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f7b2a33a-5708-4990-a9d4-a18a4b8e2bcd) | ![Send restored after authoritative refresh](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2f193de6-cab8-4076-9f88-34345ad5813c) | Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi

items.title: Cisco修補Nexus 9000系列交換器重大遠端程式碼執行漏洞
items.summary: Cisco修補Nexus 9000系列交換器的重大漏洞CVE-2026-20212，影響搭載Silicon One ASIC的機型，以及這些機型對應的NX-OS 10.x版軟體，Cisco已發布修補版本，建議用戶使用Software Checker確認自身交換器所對應的NX-OS修補版本。

items.title: OpenAI籲美國制定強制AI安全規範，要求頂尖AI業者接受獨立評估
items.summary: 頂尖AI模型的自主操作能力持續提升，既有安全控管是否跟得上也成為產業焦點。OpenAI於9月9日呼籲美國建立聯邦層級的強制性AI安全規範，主要適用於開發頂尖AI系統、資源充足的少數業者，要求依模型能力與風險接受安全測試及獨立評估，並強化網路安全防護與重大事件通報。

items.title: 多個中國駭客組織利用漏洞利用工具包BlueMoon，串連Chrome與Windows零時差漏洞從事攻擊
items.summary: 9月9日資安公司Proofpoint指出，他們從8月底發現使用漏洞利用工具包BlueMoon的活動，此工具包串連兩個Chrome零時差漏洞，以及一個Windows近日修補的零時差漏洞，而對於攻擊者的身分，最早使用的是被稱做TA412、APT31、Violet Typhoon，或JungleBamboo的中國駭客組織，後續該公司看到UNK_LateNight、UNK_Dou
